name: Awei T51 True Wireless Sports Earbuds ( 6-Month Official Warranty )
description:
Bluetooth chip: Jerry 6973D4

Bluetooth version: V 5.4

Support agreement: HSP、HFP、A2DP、AVRCP

Battery capacity: 35mAh (battery without protective board, headphone board lithium protection IC)

Charging compartment battery capacity: 300mAh (with protective board)

Charging time: 1.0H

Charging for 10 minutes, listening to music for 180 minutes

Call time: 4H

Play time: 5.5 hours

Standby duration: 200H

Speaker specifications: Φ10mm

Sensitivity: 100 ± 3DB

Impedance: 16 Ω

Maximum transmission distance: 10M

Voice prompt: Supports

Multi point connection: not supported

Wearing method: In ear style

Instructions in both Chinese and English

Interface: TYPE-C

Product size: 61.26 * * 46 * 24.87mm

Waterproof rating: IPX6 level, strong waterproof and sweat proof function (only for headphones, the charging case is not waterproof)

Additional accessories: USB charging cable, instruction manual, size earplugs
